title: Proximity proof (runtime)
description: Runtime cryptographic proof of physical proximity between two parties at a handoff. Sister to figaro-proximity-policy (which commits the band at agreement signing). Runtime-attested: content is fresh per attestation, no byte-equality cross-check against committed sectionData. Off-chain consumers should verify proof.band == policy.band when needed.

fields.name: band
fields.description: Detection modality used for this proof. Off-chain consumers should cross-check this matches the committed policy band.

fields.name: deviceSig
fields.description: Signed witness payload from a paired device (65 bytes raw → 132 hex chars min, padded; up to 512 bytes raw).
